title: Notting Hill Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical care, local hazards, and primary supply locations for Notting Hill and North Kensington.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- St Mary's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Praed Street, Paddington, W2 1NY. From Notting Hill Gate station: ~25 min walk northeast along Bayswater Road and north on Westbourne Terrace / Praed Street (~1.3 miles), or take bus 27, 7, or 23 east towards Paddington (~15 mins).
- Charing Cross Hospital: Fulham Palace Road, Hammersmith, W6 8RF. From Ladbroke Grove station: ~35 min walk south via Holland Park and Shepherd's Bush, or take bus 220 south along Ladbroke Grove towards Hammersmith (~25 mins).
- Chelsea and Westminster Hospital: 369 Fulham Road, SW10 9NH. From Notting Hill Gate station: ~35 min walk south along Kensington Church Street and Earl's Court Road (~1.7 miles), or take bus 328 south towards Chelsea (~20 mins).

2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres (UTC):
- St Mary's Urgent Treatment Centre: Ground Floor, Cambridge Wing, St Mary's Hospital, Praed Street, W2 1NY. Accessible via bus 27 or 23 from Notting Hill Gate.
- Parsons Green Walk-in Centre: 5-7 Parsons Green, SW6 4UL. From Westbourne Park / Ladbroke Grove: take bus 220 south towards Fulham.

3. Local Hazards & Flood Risks:
- The Grand Union Canal (Paddington Branch) runs along the northern fringe near Kensal Road and Ladbroke Grove; minor breach risks exist along towpaths.
- Surface water runoff pooling frequently accumulates in the low-lying hollows beneath the Westway (A40) flyover and around Westbourne Park rail underpasses.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
Pharmacies and large supermarkets along Notting Hill Gate, Portobello Road, Ladbroke Grove, and Pembridge Road stock shelf-stable food, bottled water, hygiene items, and emergency first-aid products.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
